_comment: Guided tour for MFD Prepare: point at Browse, then Prepare, then read the report. Steps wait for the user to press the buttons.

steps.title: A check, not a copy
steps.text:
An MFD fit reads a burst folder on trust: that every burst's photons can be found, that the photon indices are read with the right convention, and that each detector is defined by the right channels and micro-time window.

This tool reads the folder exactly as the fit will and reports each of those, before a fit depends on them. Nothing is moved or rewritten.

steps.title: Choose the folder
steps.text: Browse… to the analysis folder burst search wrote — the one holding bi4_bur and Info — or to bi4_bur itself.

await.hint: Press Browse… and pick a burst folder.

steps.title: Prepare it
steps.text: Prepare resolves the photon files, detects the photon-index convention, and recomputes every detector's counts from the photons. Reading the photons takes a few seconds.

steps.title: Read the count agreement last
steps.text:
Each detector's count agreement is the fraction of bursts whose count, recomputed from the photons, equals the .bur column. ok needs 0.98.

An UNVERIFIED detector would put photons under the wrong colour; the MFD fit refuses it. Record the detectors in the analysis manifest, or pass them explicitly, and prepare again.
